name: photo-to-zine-postcard
title_zh: 把一张照片变成可寄出的极简双面明信片
tagline_zh: 照片塞进信封太无聊？它替你裁成 2:3，正面留白加手绘小元素，背面自动配三色样卡和可写地址栏——寄出去像份小zin。
tagline_en: Bored of plain prints? It crops your photo to 2:3, adds a sparse hand-drawn motif, and builds a matching back.
desc_en: Turn a user-provided photograph into a minimal two-sided 2:3 zine-style postcard. Preserve the original photo above, then create a sparse hand-drawn source-specific motif, minimal metadata, three sampled color swatches, and a matching functional postcard back.
why_zh: 不是滤镜套壳，而是真正重排版面：原图保持在上，下方生成专属线条母题、三色采样和元数据。
why_en: Not a filter—it re-lays the page: original stays on top, then generates a source-specific line motif, three sampled swatches.
limit_zh: 只吃单张照片，输出为 PDF 或图片，不处理多图拼贴；手绘母题是程序生成的抽象线条，不是写实插画。
limit_en: Single photo only; output is PDF/image, no collage. Motif is abstract procedural line art, not realistic. Back has no real barcode or postage—just a.
title_en: Turn one photo into a minimal two-sided postcard
